comments.author: Visitor
comments.body: You may acquire this skill from Company Colonies that have a Guild Building (specifically, from the Adventure Guildmaster), or from the Merchant GM in San Francisco. It costs 1,000,000 ducats wherever you buy it. American translation notes sold in in the ports of Santo Domingo and Portobelo also work, I believe.
